status_detail: 7 verified hashes published for this review date: 2 Kothamine samples documented by Malwarebytes and 5 SparroWocky samples added by ESET Research. One URLhaus SHA-256 candidate was withheld because the live URLhaus record does not display the submitted hash and provides no named malware family; the bare MalwareBazaar export was not used without metadata.
blocker: The public MalwareBazaar recent-hash export provides volume but not the per-hash family and confirmation metadata required by this repository. The URLhaus candidate also failed exact-hash provenance reconciliation. Additional entries require metadata-rich authenticated access or direct source publications.
